description: Auth endpoints enforce rate limiting and account lockout (brute-force defense) with in-memory primary state and Redis for cross-replica coordination.

requirements.description: Authentication endpoints (login, register, password reset, MFA challenge) must enforce per-IP and per-account rate limiting. After a configurable threshold of failed attempts, the account enters a lockout state for a configurable duration. Primary rate-limit counters are in-memory for latency; Redis provides cross-replica coordination so lockout is consistent across horizontally scaled instances. Lockout state and counter reset must be auditable.
requirements.title: Rate Limiting and Account Lockout for Auth Endpoints
